content:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: service=canary-deployments severity=critical — p50 latency +1200ms, 5xx rate 3.9% (>= threshold 2.5%). page_id=PD12345

emily.chen: saw the page — canary rollout started ~2m ago, traffic 10% to new model. Oncall taking it. @raj.patel are you oncall?

raj.patel: I'm on it, acked PD. taking lead. :eyes:

pagerduty-bot: PD Alert PD12345 acknowledged by raj.patel at 2026-03-15T02:12:05Z

marta.santiago: quick check — the canary pods in eu-west-1 show OOMs. attaching last lines from pod logs:

```
[2026-03-15T02:10:23Z] ERROR oom-killer: process=redwood-serve-0 killed
[2026-03-15T02:10:24Z] ERROR runtime: allocation failed: out of memory
```

sre-l2: any recent kernel/quant changes in this deploy? Could be memory regression from new tensor concat.

emily.chen: this release added small quant path change and updated batcher config. I can divert traffic back to stable and trigger rollback if needed. Suggest immediate traffic divert to stable by 8% (keep canary at 2% for probe). Command to change routing:

```
# feature-flag API
curl -X POST "https://routing.internal/api/v1/route" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ROUTE_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"service":"text-gen","canary_pct":2,"stable_pct":98}'
```

emily.chen: applying now.

pipeline-bot: routing change accepted — canary_pct=2 -> applied in 12s. (trace: cb3f7)

raj.patel: good. also please start rollback if pods keep OOMing. emily, can you run the revert pipeline? If not, I'll trigger.

emily.chen: starting rollback pipeline: `ci/release/revert/2026-03-15-746` — kicking off.

pipeline-bot: rollback job queued (job_id=rb-746). logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/rb-746

marta.santiago: after divert, 5xx rate dropped to 0.8% in eu-west-1, p50 back to baseline. Looks like traffic shift helped. Still seeing 1 pod crash every ~30s — rollback in progress will help.

raj.patel: monitoring customer impact. Does support show incoming errors? @emily.chen

emily.chen: support: 3 tickets in last 10m related to timeouts, all from EU customers. Estimated affected ~1.8k requests total; overall traffic ~1.1M reqs in that window (~0.16%). No major outages. Saving logs to /tmp/canary_impact_1900004321.log

sre-l2: tagging escalation to L2 for post-rollback validation. @marta.santiago please validate no regressions in stable after rollback.

marta.santiago: on it. running smoke tests against stable.

pipeline-bot: rollback job rb-746 succeeded. new image pinned: image@sha256:abc123 -> previous image@sha256:xyz789

emily.chen: rollout reverted. Confirming pods restarting on stable image.

marta.santiago: smoke tests green. no errors seen in 5m window. 5xx rates normalized.

pagerduty-bot: PD Alert PD12345 resolved by raj.patel at 2026-03-15T02:24:55Z — resolution: rollback + traffic diversion

raj.patel: marking incident mitigated. will open an incident doc and postmortem. Short summary:
- Cause: memory regression in quant path introduced in this deploy
- Mitigation: diverted canary traffic to stable, reverted release
- Customer impact: transient timeouts for ~0.16% of requests, ~3 support tickets; no major data loss
- Next steps: revert patch in repo, add mem tests to CI, increase canary ramp safety thresholds

emily.chen: filing postmortem doc draft: https://docs.internal/incidents/1900004321-canary-oom

incident-bot: Incident PD12345 closed. Conversation moved to incident page. If follow-ups required, tag #postmortems.

raj.patel: thanks everyone. good coordination. :tada:
